additional_info.subject: RE: ID0378723-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / RN 170002799] LED doesn't work CRM:00643000920
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr., Szymon,
I hope this message finds you well.
We have reviewed the error flags on the SCB, and unfortunately, the issue is still active.
Based on your analysis, we recommend you check the specific parts of the schematic provided below.
There might be a chance of a loose connection between the fan automation and its status, which we are utilizing for the SCB flag.
Additionally, please inspect the contactor QA30-31, which is being used to automate the fan.
Could you kindly review the schematic and proceed with the necessary checks?
Also, please keep in mind that during the intervention, it would be advisable to carry spare parts such as the KF5 module, fans GQ2 and GQ3, as well as contactors QA30 and QA31, in case replacements are necessary.
Looking forward to your feedback.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav
